SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(address, ' ', 1) AS province, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_visitor_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND address IS NOT NULL AND address != '' AND address != '内网IP' AND address != '未知'
AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY province ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(address, ' ', -1) AS city, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_visitor_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND address IS NOT NULL AND address != '' AND address != '内网IP' AND address != '未知'
AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY city ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_visitor_log WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
